about: At age 65, Naprosyn overlaps with Natrilix SR and the record shows no supply of an ACE inhibitor or ARB within 60 days either side of the NSAID supply.
At age 74, naproxen overlaps with hydrochlorothiazide and the record shows no supply of an ACE inhibitor or ARB within 60 days either side of the NSAID supply.
Perindopril covers the full naproxen course from 2025-10-31 to 2025-11-02, so there is no finding.
